ui.purpose: All UI copy: headings, labels, body, buttons.

ui-heading.purpose: Section titles and card headers; same face as body, 700 weight.

data.purpose: Dates, dosages, drug names, timestamps only — never decorative.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Resting cards, record entries, suggestion chips.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pill-shaped amber action button; the only fill color allowed to mean "act on this."
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #f5a524; color: #241a02; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 9px 16px; font-family: 'Sora', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #dc8f10; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7c5cff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action: Refresh, Delete, Cancel, Enter manually.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: #ffffff; color: #5c6474; border: 1px solid #cdd3e2; border-radius: 999px; padding: 9px 16px; font-family: 'Sora', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #1b2029; border-color: #5c6474; }

components.name: Nav Tab (active, Ask)
components.description: Rail navigation item in its active state — tinted background carries identity, never a border stripe.
components.css: .ds-nav-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; width: 100%; padding: 11px 13px; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; border: none; font-family: 'Sora', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #5c6474; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; } .ds-nav-tab:hover { background: #eef1f8; color: #1b2029; } .ds-nav-tab--active { background: #efeaff; color: #4a2fd6; } .ds-nav-dot { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: #7c5cff; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Record Card
components.description: A saved prescription; the initials badge is the card's only color accent — no border-left stripe.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e3e7f0; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(27,32,41,0.06); overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Sora', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 14px 18px; } .ds-badge { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 10px; background: #e0f8f5; color: #086b60; display: grid; place-items: center; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-card-head h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 700; color: #1b2029; } .ds-date { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #6b7280; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field with mist fill; focus ring is the one place violet appears outside the Ask surface.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #cdd3e2; border-radius: 10px; background: #eef1f8; font-family: 'Sora', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #1b2029; padding: 9px 12px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b7280; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #7c5cff; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #efeaff; }

components.name: Source Tag
components.description: Always teal regardless of context — means "this came from a saved record."
components.css: .ds-chip-source { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; background: #e0f8f5; color: #086b60; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 999px; }

narrative.overview: The product is a household's own private prescription record, not a chatbot with a health-app skin. Its visual system reads as a bright, tabbed record: distinct labeled sections (Ask, Records, Upload) the way a family binder has labeled dividers, rendered in clean modern surfaces rather than literal paper texture. Three bright, distinct hues identify the sections — violet for Ask, teal for Records, amber for Upload — with amber carrying the brand mark and every primary action across the whole app. Everything else stays quiet: white surfaces, soft cool-gray neutrals, no gradients, no dark mode as a default identity. This direction replaced an earlier "medical chart" concept executed in manila and clinical red; that palette was explicitly rejected for feeling dark and institutional. The rejection is durable: no red as a brand or primary-accent color, no cream/manila/tan grounds. Red is reserved strictly for error/danger semantics, never for identity or primary actions.
keyCharacteristics: Bright white surfaces on a soft cool-gray page background — never cream, tan, or dark.
One brand accent (amber) for primary actions and the mark; violet and teal are section-identity colors only, never primary-action colors.
One UI type family (Sora) carries every weight of hierarchy; a monospace (IBM Plex Mono) is reserved strictly for chart data.
Soft, generous rounding (pills for actions and chips, 16px cards) — friendly without being childish.
Chat renders as dated, sourced "chart entries," not chat bubbles with a personality.

rules.name: The No-Red Rule
rules.body: Red (#b42318) exists only to mean "something is wrong" — validation errors, failed loads, destructive-hover states. It never appears as a brand, accent, or decorative color.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Amber is the only color allowed to mean "act on this." Violet and teal identify content and sections; they never appear on a primary call-to-action button.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Sora carries 100% of UI copy; a second UI-text face never appears. IBM Plex Mono is the only exception, and only for literal record data.

rules.name: The Soft Rest Rule
rules.body: Nothing at rest uses a shadow stronger than shadow-sm. A heavier shadow always means "this is floating above the page," never decoration on a static card.

dos: Do keep amber as the only "act on this" color; every primary button and the brand mark stay amber.
Do use violet and teal exclusively as section/content identity — never as button fills.
Do set dates, dosages, drug names, and timestamps in IBM Plex Mono; everything else stays in Sora.
Do carry a card or tab's color identity via a tinted background fill or small dot, never a border stripe.
donts: Don't introduce red, manila, cream, or dark-mode-as-default — this direction was chosen specifically to replace that palette.
Don't add a colored border-left/border-right accent to cards, list items, or callouts.
Don't use the mono face for anything that isn't literal record data.
Don't add a second UI display face; hierarchy comes from weight and size within Sora.
